topic: how to link chase bank to paypal
slug: how to link chase bank to paypal

steps.narration: Open the Chase app and sign in.
Tap your TOTAL CHECKING account, then tap "Manage account".
Tap "Show card number" on your debit card screen and verify with the one-time code.
Write down the debit card number, expiration date, and security code.
For a bank-account link, tap "Show details" and copy the routing number and account number.
Open PayPal, go to Wallet, tap "Link a card or bank account", and enter the card details, or tap "Link a bank account" and enter the routing and account numbers.
PayPal confirms instantly for cards; for a bank link it makes two small deposits within 1-2 business days. Enter them in PayPal to finish the link.
